Agent Name: VideoContentAnalysis_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The agent made the first clear error by assuming the blog post could be analyzed without actually extracting the needed information from the video. In step 3, it says to “open the link” and “watch the last video,” but then admits it cannot directly view web content and tells the user to do the task instead. This is a failure to complete the requested analysis and results in no actual identification of the command.
